about:
# Liven up your profile with songs!

***how to add song***
1. Open Geode MOD Settings
2. Put SONG ID into **Profile Song ID** Field
3. Open your profile at least once
(also don't forget to press refresh button!)
4. and **Done**

Share your theme with everyone! *(thx for UserDataAPI)*

**Bug Tips**: The song may not load at first. Please wait a few seconds or reopen the profile.

**Tip 2**: If the song failed to load or doesn't play, you may need to download it yourself.

**Tip 3**: If the song change wasn't applied, press the refresh button in the bottom-left corner of the profile.

## Support this mod
- [**Github**](https://github.com/bunchuq1122/UserTheme)

## Credit

by hiimjasmine00

***How to set up:***
1. Mod Settings
![Option 1](image.png)
2. LevelInfoLayer
![Option 2](image-1.png)
